description: Configuration class for setting up the Loan Collection of Business (COB) worker steps in a batch processing system, including thread pool setup, step definitions, and bean configurations for processing loan data.

classes.name: LoanCOBWorkerConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up COB worker steps for loan processing in batch jobs.

methods.name: loanCOBWorkerStep
methods.description: Defines the main COB worker step that processes inbound requests.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Builds the flow of steps for the COB process including initialization, locking, business logic, and reset.

methods.name: initialisationStep
methods.description: Creates a step for initializing context with optional partition parameter.

methods.name: cobTaskExecutor
methods.description: Configures thread pool executor for COB processing, switching to synchronous if max pool size is 1.

methods.name: loanBusinessStep
methods.description: Defines the chunk-oriented step for processing loans, with optional task executor.

methods.name: applyLockStep
methods.description: Defines a step to apply locks on loans.

methods.name: resetContextStep
methods.description: Defines a step to reset processing context.

methods.name: initialiseContext
methods.description: Creates an InitialisationTasklet for setting up context.

methods.name: loanItemListener
methods.description: Creates a listener for processing loan items.

methods.name: applyLock
methods.description: Creates a tasklet to apply loan locks.

methods.name: resetContext
methods.description: Creates a tasklet to reset context.

methods.name: cobWorkerItemReader
methods.description: Creates a reader for loan items.

methods.name: cobWorkerItemProcessor
methods.description: Creates a processor for loan items.

methods.name: cobWorkerItemWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer for loan items.
